response.best_proof: A close-up photo of the console showing the actual unit and system settings
seller_claims_unsupported: exact condition of the specific unit being sold
response.drop_reason: Shop inventory photo showing multiple units and a business watermark rather than the specific second-hand item for sale.
response.failure_mode: AI might assume the shop display of multiple units represents the single item and accept commercial vendor promotional material as a peer-to-peer used listing.
